## [1.1.0](https://github.com/sebsebseb9b/lockstar-clock-patch/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-12)

### ✨ New Features

* add re-sign only test patch for LockStar ([84c76da](https://github.com/sebsebseb9b/lockstar-clock-patch/commit/84c76da398823767d29a33fb99cc7adb1f2ec584))

patches.name: Center lock screen clock
patches.description: Anchors the lock screen clock to the horizontal center of the screen. Your vertical position is kept. Re-save the clock in LockStar after installing.

patches.name: Re-sign only (test)
patches.description: Does nothing. Select only this patch to test whether a re-signed LockStar opens at all.

patches.name: Use default clock position
patches.description: Alternative to 'Center lock screen clock': makes SystemUI use its stock (centered) clock position. Your vertical position is not kept. Enable only one of the two.
